why: Named, shrinking exemptions for gaps the futureproof capstone (governance/futureproof/e2e.py, issue #1193) MEASURED. An entry is honoured only while it is listed and is matched EXACTLY (mechanism + link + gate), so it cannot widen to cover a different breakage. A broken link with no entry FAILS by name, so a NEW blind or non-falsifiable gate is never waved through; an entry that matches nothing FAILS as a stale exemption and must be removed, so this list can only shrink and can never outlive its fix.
